title: The Great Glass Elevator  Symbol Algebra for Weave Navigation
description: SQL, arithmetic, email routing, and hashtags all share the same symbols. These symbols form a universal algebra for navigating ANY direction through the feed weave. Roald Dahl's elevator goes up/down/sideways/slantways. So do these operators.
author: Kevin + chipmunk-easel

@.weave: ROUTE TO  direct a message/feed to a specific receptor

#.unix: #! shebang  tells the system HOW to interpret
#.weave: TAG  classify a feed by topic. #science #rust #art
#.direction: lateral ? groups peers by shared attribute

%.weave: PATTERN MATCH  find feeds matching a fuzzy shape

&.sql: not standard (use AND), but bitwise in some dialects
&.arithmetic: bitwise AND  both bits must be 1
&.weave: INTERSECT  feeds that are BOTH #science AND #rust

*.rust: *dereference  follow the pointer to the value
*.weave: ALL  every feed, no filter. The catch-all receptor.
*.direction: omnidirectional ? the glass elevator goes everywhere

**.glob: **/*.json  recursive, go DEEP into all subdirectories
**.weave: DEEP SEARCH  recurse through all references, follow every link
**.direction: depth-first ? the elevator goes DOWN through all floors

|.unix: pipe  output of one becomes input of next
|.logic: OR / bitwise OR  union of two sets

!.weave: EXCLUDE  !stale means NOT stale feeds. The negative receptor.
!.direction: repulsive ? pushes away from a category

~.weave: FUZZY MATCH  feeds approximately like this shape
~.direction: approximate ? the elevator goes NEAR a floor, not exactly to it

+.weave: SUB-ROUTE  narrow within a receptor. tamison+science gets science subset of tamison's feed
+.direction: refinement ? same floor but a specific room

^.weave: STARTS WITH  feeds whose identity begins with this root

the_query_language.description: Combine symbols to navigate the weave in any direction. This is the Great Glass Elevator.

examples.sql: SELECT * FROM feeds WHERE receptor = 'tamison' AND 'science' IN tags

examples.meaning: Feeds tagged BOTH rust AND bioinformatics
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM feeds WHERE 'rust' IN tags AND 'bioinformatics' IN tags

examples.meaning: Feeds matching 'klein' OR 'null' anywhere in content
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM feeds WHERE title LIKE '%klein%' OR title LIKE '%null%'

examples.meaning: Send to newsletter receptor, science-tagged, exclude stale
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM feeds WHERE state != 'CONSTANCE' AND 'science' IN tags

examples.meaning: Deep recursive search, route to gaia, approximately topology-shaped
examples.sql: WITH RECURSIVE ... SELECT * FROM feeds WHERE topic ~* 'topolog'

the_surprise_party.scenario: Find everyone in a group who knows Greg BUT only the ones who haven't met Wanda yet, tag them for the orange tennis ball invite
the_surprise_party.sql: SELECT members FROM group WHERE knows_greg = true AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT person FROM encounters WHERE other_person = 'Wanda') ? INSERT INTO invites (tag) VALUES ('orange-tennis-ball')
the_surprise_party.email: orange-tennis-ball+greg-surprise@primals.eco ? routes only to the pre-Wanda subset
the_surprise_party.biology: Express the Greg-receptor AND suppress the Wanda-antigen. Only cells with this phenotype get the orange signal molecule. This IS immune system logic  opsonize the subset, exclude the incompatible, deliver the payload.
the_surprise_party.insight: The surprise party query is a SET OPERATION on a SOCIAL GRAPH filtered by TEMPORAL CONDITION (before meeting). SQL does this. Email routing does this. The immune system does this. They're the SAME ALGEBRA.

glue_languages.description: SQL, regex, email headers, Unix pipes, arithmetic, and Rust's type system all use the same 12 symbols to navigate structure. They're glue languages  they don't compute, they ROUTE.
glue_languages.the_elevator: Roald Dahl's Great Glass Elevator goes up, down, sideways, slantways, longways, backways, squareways, frontways, and any-other-ways-you-can-think-of. These 12 symbols do the same thing for data. You're not limited to rows and columns. You go in ANY direction.
glue_languages.why_glass: Glass = transparent. You can SEE where you're going. SQL shows you the query. Email shows you the address. The # shows you the tag. Unlike opaque APIs, symbol algebra is READABLE. The Great Glass Elevator works because you can see through the walls.

weave_directions.lateral: & and #  group peers, intersect categories. Sideways through the weave.
weave_directions.medial: @ and ^  route to self, start from origin. Inward to the center.
weave_directions.outward: * and ** and |  broadcast, expand, union. Outward to the world.
weave_directions.temporal: ! and ~  exclude past states, approximate future ones. Through time.
weave_directions.depth: ** and +  recursive descent, sub-addressing. Down through layers.
weave_directions.pattern: % and ~  wildcard, fuzzy match. Diagonal through possibility space.

implementation_sketch.description: Wire this into the feed system as a query parser
implementation_sketch.example_email: science+live@primals.eco ? returns LIVE science feeds as email digest

dependencies.discovers: 12 symbols shared across SQL/email/regex/arithmetic/Unix form a universal navigation algebra. The Great Glass Elevator. Goes in any direction.
